svg.text: Course: CS203 DBMS | SVNIT Surat - 16 Normalized Tables (3NF/BCNF), 6 Triggers, 2 Procedures, 3 Views

g.text: KEY DBMS CONCEPTS DEMONSTRATED IN THIS SCHEMA
[PK] Primary Key: Unique identifier, B-Tree indexed
[FK] Foreign Key: ON UPDATE CASCADE, ON DELETE RESTRICT / CASCADE / SET NULL
Clinical Cooldown Trigger: trg_check_donation_cooldown raises SIGNAL SQLSTATE 45000 if <90 days
ACID Transaction Procedure: sp_interhospital_transfer with START TRANSACTION, COMMIT and ROLLBACK
Emergency Matching Procedure: sp_match_emergency_donors ranks EXACT vs COMPATIBLE ABO/Rh groups
3NF / BCNF Normalization: Zero transitive dependencies, city coordinates and blood groups isolated
View 3: v_eligible_donors (Active, available and cooldown checked)
